project_type: MEAN stack — Angular 17 standalone (client) + Node.js/Express (server) + MongoDB via Mongoose
build_system: Angular CLI 17 (ng build/ng serve) for client; plain Node.js / npm scripts for server. No monorepo tooling — two separate package.json files.
test_framework: Client: Karma + Jasmine (ng test). Server: Jest (npm test). No existing test coverage — tests are not run as part of the workflow.
build_command: Client: cd client && npm run build. Server: no compile step — runs directly with node.
test_command: Client: cd client && ng build --configuration development (compile check). Server: cd server && node src/server.js (smoke test).
verification_instructions: 1. cd server && npm run dev -- starts on :3000. 2. In a second terminal cd client && npm start -- starts on :4200 with proxy to :3000. 3. Open http://localhost:4200, register accounts, test flows manually per plan.md item 19.
environment_constraints: server/.env must exist before starting the server — file is missing from repo. MongoDB must be running locally or a URI provided. Client proxy.conf.json already routes /api to localhost:3000.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code conventions: Express routes use authenticate middleware from middleware/auth.js; Angular services use HttpClient with environment.apiUrl prefix; standalone Angular components.
key_patterns: Server: controllers use AppError + next(error) pattern; all protected routes must import and use authenticate from middleware/auth.js; Notification.create requires {user, type, title, message, relatedId}; Mentorship.create requires {student, mentor, request, status}. Client: services inject HttpClient and use environment.apiUrl; standalone components import CommonModule, FormsModule, etc. explicitly; AuthService.currentUserSubject stores User (not {user,profile}). Angular interceptors are functional (not class-based) in app.config.ts withInterceptors.
